text:
anna: Heads up - deploybot failed to promote the staging image to EU during the 10:00-11:00 change window. EU ECR mirror skipped provenance annotation for the build.
ben: saw the alert. Which image? tag or digest?
anna: tag=release-1.42.0-eu, digest=sha256:3a7f...c9b
deploybot: Promotion blocked: missing provenance annotation for image release-1.42.0-eu (sha256:3a7f...c9b) in eu-west-1. See: https://deploy.internal/release/1716123456 :warning:
olga: that's from the backfill we ran overnight. multipart upload possibly finished before attestation webhook responded.
sam: can we re-run attestation-only, or must we retag + push?
ben: attestation-only should work if manifest exists. Try: 
```sh
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/release --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:3a7f...c9b --registry-id 111222333444 --region eu-west-1
```
ben: if manifest is present we can trigger provenance lambda to annotate.
anna: I ran batch-get-image and it returned the manifest, but deploybot still rejects because manifest lacks cosign annotation `cosign.sigstore.dev/provenance`.
olga: starting attestation job attest-job/1716123600 now.
olga: attest-job started. ETA ~2m.
deploybot: attest-job/1716123600 succeeded. Added annotation cosign.sigstore.dev/provenance to sha256:3a7f...c9b.
sam: nice. Try promote again.
anna: running: `/deploy promote release-1.42.0-eu --to=eu-cluster --canary=10%`
deploybot: Promotion queued. Pre-checks: OK. Starting rollout.
ben: keeping canary at 10% for 30m, watching p50/p95 latency and 5xx rate. rollback if regressions.
anna: updating release notes: "EU mirror attestation backfilled; no user-facing changes." Adding window note.
olga: follow-up: add a guard in mirror backfill to wait for attestation webhook or retry on missing annotation. Filed ARCH-451 (assignee: olga).
sam: also add metric mirror.missing_attestation.count to the pipeline.
anna: closing thread - rollout progressing. ping if canary goes bad. :thumbsup:
